report.summary: Recommendation: needs review. Not enough evidence: cannot tell whether py reaches level 2. Estimated levels: py level 1 (needs 2), sql level 3 (needs 3), ds level 2 (needs 2). Suspected (insufficient corroboration) misconception: Believes general-purpose (comparison) sorting such as sorted() takes O(n) time, so sorting first is effectively free compared with a single linear scan. Suspected (insufficient corroboration) misconception: Believes that after an exception is caught, execution goes back to the try block and continues with the line after the one that raised. Suspected (insufficient corroboration) misconception: Believes list.sort() returns the sorted list, not knowing it sorts in place and returns None (unlike sorted(), which returns a new list). Suspected (insufficient corroboration) misconception: Believes other sessions see a transaction's changes as soon as each statement runs, before COMMIT.
